summary_en: The Yamagata Bank raised its FY2024 dividend forecast to 28.0 yen per share from 27.0 yen, an increase of 1.0 yen. The revision reflects stronger-than-expected earnings performance.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Earnings and Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: The Yamagata Bank announced a revision of its FY2024 dividend per share forecast from 27.0 yen to 28.0 yen, representing an increase of 1.0 yen. This adjustment was made following stronger-than-anticipated financial performance for the fiscal year. The bank's earnings outlook has been raised, prompting management to enhance shareholder distributions in line with improved profitability.
